findings.description: _apply_transition does not set previous_phase and escalation_reason when transitioning to ESCALATE via the transition table (10 phases: PLAN failed, PLAN_ITERATE failed, PLAN_REVIEW max_iter, PLAN_FIX stuck, IMPLEMENT failed, IMPL_ITERATE failed, IMPL_REVIEW max_iter, IMPL_FIX stuck, VAL_REVIEW max_iter, VAL_FIX stuck). Only enter_escalate() sets these fields, but it's only called explicitly in _phase_gatekeeper and exception/gate handlers. The ESCALATE resume path (transition resolved -> _previous_phase) depends on previous_phase; without it, _apply_transition raises ValueError('ESCALATE resolved but previous_phase is None').
findings.resolution: In _apply_transition, after computing next_phase, add: if next_phase == 'ESCALATE': state.previous_phase = old_phase; state.escalation_reason = f'{old_phase} transitioned to ESCALATE via outcome {outcome!r}'; ensure total_iterations incremented exactly once.

findings.description: apply_outcome_or_escalate bypasses projection for its internal escalation write. When apply-outcome fails (non-zero exit), the function writes ESCALATE state directly to JSON (raw dict manipulation) without calling persist_and_project. The host-driven protocol suppresses projection after failed apply-outcome, but the internal escalation write succeeds and should be projected. On resume, reconcile repairs, but live projection is missing during the failure window.
findings.resolution: Call persist_and_project after the internal escalation write, or refactor to use save_state + projection callback. Ensure projection occurs for this successful state mutation.

findings.description: Missing integration test for full host-driven projection protocol. SKILL.md requires 'After every successfully persisted runner mutation — init, transition, apply-outcome, record-state-only-archetype, and gate-answer — immediately run project-state --mode submit'. Test suite has unit tests for each runner command in isolation but no integration test chaining multiple commands with projection enabled, verifying submit after each successful mutation and suppression after failures.
findings.resolution: Add integration test in test_phase_projection_runner.py that drives init -> project-state submit -> transition -> project-state submit -> apply-outcome -> project-state submit -> record-state-only-archetype -> project-state submit -> gate-answer -> project-state submit, with a spy adapter verifying projection calls and exit-code-gated suppression.

findings.description: No test verifies previous_phase/escalation_reason are set on transition TO ESCALATE. Tests for ESCALATE resume manually construct LoopState with previous_phase='IMPLEMENT' but never test that these fields are correctly populated when the loop transitions TO ESCALATE via _apply_transition or enter_escalate. This allowed the critical defect to go undetected.
findings.resolution: Add test driving a phase (e.g., PLAN with outcome 'failed') through _apply_transition or run_loop and asserting previous_phase/escalation_reason are set on resulting ESCALATE state.

findings.description: _phase_gatekeeper returns unused 'escalate' outcome after calling enter_escalate. When GATEKEEPER outcome is 'escalate', it calls enter_escalate (mutating state to ESCALATE) then returns 'escalate'. Main loop sees state.current_phase != phase, persists, and continues — the returned outcome is discarded due to continue. Functionally correct but confusing and violates pattern where phase handlers return outcomes for _apply_transition to apply.
findings.resolution: Refactor _phase_gatekeeper to not return an outcome when enter_escalate is called, or restructure so ESCALATE transitions follow the same pattern as other phases. Consider having enter_escalate return a sentinel that the main loop recognizes.

findings.description: Work-queue phase projection ownership, canonical task identity, and idempotence correctly implemented. QueueProjectionAdapter derives projection_key exactly from (change_id, current_phase, total_iterations). Submit mode calls try_submit_work then falls through to try_reconcile_work_projection only on exact 409 reconciliation_required. Reconcile mode calls try_reconcile_work_projection directly. Duplicate replay returns canonical task. Capability snapshot reused across all bridge calls. All 7 adapter tests pass.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D7, D9 and spec scenarios.

findings.description: Stale-label cleanup bounded and idempotent with adapter-owned label isolation. Reconcile mode lists up to 100 double-labelled rows (change:<id> + projection:autopilot-phase), clears labels on cancelled_task_ids and any non-canonical double-labelled rows. Canonical labelling happens before stale cleanup. Ordinary change-labelled issues never selected. _MAX_CLEANUP_ROWS=100 enforced. Partial label failures return bounded degraded result; resume retries entire idempotent repair.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D9.

findings.description: Coordination bridge HTTP-200 business failures correctly treated as projection failures. _require_projection_operation_success wraps try_projection_issue_list and try_projection_issue_update: if HTTP 200 but response.success is not True, converts to status=failed with bounded reason. Prevents silent label-update failures where coordinator returns 200 with error payload.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D9.

findings.description: PostgreSQL migration 037 correctly removes overloads and enforces issue-row claim exclusion with label fallback. Migration drops two legacy claim_task overloads, creates single implementation with task_type <> 'issue' filter. Trigger emits projection.labels_changed event when projection:autopilot-phase label changes, deriving change_id from NEW labels with OLD-label fallback on removal. Ensures board visibility via SSE and kanban polling.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D5.

findings.description: Runner pending, validation, operational, and escalation exit semantics match SKILL.md protocol. All runner subcommands return exit codes per SKILL.md: init (0 success/idempotent, 1 op-fail, 2 validation), transition (0 success/gate-pending, 1 op-fail, 2 validation), apply-outcome (0 success/gate-pending, 1 op-fail, 2 validation), record-state-only-archetype (0 success, 1 op-fail, 2 validation), gate-answer (0 success, 2 no-pending/mismatch, 1 op-fail), gate-check (0 ask, 3 continue, 4 parked, 1 eval-fail, 2 validation), project-state (0 ok, 1 degraded/op-fail, 2 validation). Verified by test_runner_transition_validation_and_project_state_io_exit_codes.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches SKILL.md protocol.

findings.description: SSE snapshot coalescing and unsubscribe behavior correctly implemented. sse_event_generator registers callbacks in try/finally with off_event on all exit paths (normal close, CancelledError, exception). Backpressure coalesces >100 events/sec into single snapshot. projection.labels_changed events set projection_refresh_pending flag, deduplicated to one snapshot. Tests verify coalescing and backpressure drain.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D5.

findings.description: Coordinator-free isolation enforced via AST and call-spy tests. test_autopilot_and_runner_do_not_eagerly_import_projection_module verifies no top-level import of queue_projection in autopilot.py or runner.py. test_coordinator_free_run_cannot_call_projection_transport monkeypatches bridge helpers to fail if called, runs run_loop with queue_projection_fn=None, confirms no projection calls. runner.py imports queue_projection lazily only inside _cmd_project_state.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches design D10.

findings.description: OpenAPI parity and test quality verified. openspec/contracts/agent-coordinator/openapi/work-queue.yaml declares ProjectionKey, /work/reconcile, typed 403/409/422 problem responses. test_projection_openapi_problem_contract_matches_runtime validates schema matches runtime. All 90 OpenSpec validations pass. Ruff linting passes. Full test suites pass: 418 autopilot, 96 coordination-bridge, 74 coordinator queue/issue tests.
findings.resolution: No action required. Implementation matches work-packages.yaml verification steps.
